identity: Register only after actual successful format7 construction, vector read and handler selection, from scoped CPU completion evidence. SavedPC, writeSSW, WB1 and raw frame bytes alone do not establish producer completion.

A pure backend callback certifies one contiguous opaque RAM-storage range. All aliases share its key; the key is never substituted for an architectural CPU physical address. Unknown ranges cannot establish identity.
Only exact storage identity survives. Writes overlapping PC/format/EA/SSW invalidate before transfer, including same-value and later-failed writes. SavedSR-only edits remain permitted.

Observe only genuine existing RTE PC/format/SSW reads. Actual unchanged instruction-body return with matching PC and no intervening exception is the sole consume point. No target reread, copied-byte match or reserved-field token is used.
coherence: Every non-core RAM writer must notify before writing or execute the same-CPU-thread metadata-only barrier. Native checked-write helpers notify; private/NatFeat/legacy-FPU service entry invalidates outstanding records.
FDC guest-RAM copies and ATA bulk-RAM copies execute the barrier before memcpy. Initial 24-bit DMA addresses do not establish immunity for FastRAM: transfers can cross16MiB.

A genuine successful completed-frame RTE grants transient architectural IRQ eligibility until the next actual instruction. Raw MMURESTART remains set for native dispatcher/compiler successor holdoff; native dispatch also leaves its compiled chain on the explicit successful-RTE event. A zero-budget run does not consume IRQ eligibility.
Storage callback or bus replacement invalidates existing identities; bus replacement also disables the profile and its mapping contract. Reset removes all identities, events and callbacks.
fallback: Read/CM/CT/FPU/traced or unfinished producers do not borrow ordinary completed-write identity. Copied/relocated, unknown, overwritten, consumed, ambiguous and untracked frames retain conservative restart holdoff.

Capacity or serial exhaustion drops all identities and holds the conservative profile until reset/reselection. Failed/partial RTE never consumes an identity; internal-state load faults retain halt priority.

This remains opt-in with backend writer-coherence obligations. Full writer-path audit, real MFP/native/alias/DMA after tests, frozen platform regressions and native owner acceptance are separate qualification gates. No paged-MMU, new FPU, default or RC3 admission follows from this policy.
